name: Indian Metals & Ferro Alloys Ltd (IMFA)
tagline: India's largest fully integrated ferro chrome producer (~20% of domestic output, ~25% of exports) with captive chrome-ore mining and captive power - cheap on a cyclical basis but a slow-growth commodity story, not a re-rating candidate.
business_overview: IMFA manufactures ferro chrome (used in stainless steel production) with 190 MVA installed furnace capacity backed by 204.55 MW of captive power generation, and holds captive chrome-ore mining leases in Odisha. Backward integration into both ore and power gives it a genuine cost-of-production edge over non-integrated ferro chrome peers, and it is one of the largest exporters of ferro chrome from India. Seeded via untrusted X triage (@r_laroia, bullish, high conviction, 2026-09-13).
fundamentals_table: Poor - only ~8.9% over the past 5 years (commodity/cyclical)
~58.7%; no pledge or SEBI/going-concern issue found
fundamentals_narrative: IMFA is a well-run, integrated commodity producer trading cheap (P/E ~13x) against a respectable ~18% ROCE, but five-year revenue growth of under 9% confirms this is a cyclical ferro-chrome/stainless-steel price play, not a structural growth story. A July 2026 SEBI warning letter for insider trading by middle management (Oct-Dec 2023, cautionary, no financial penalty) was noted but is not a going-concern or fraud-tier issue and does not change the disposition.
technical_read: Stock is roughly mid-range of its wide 52-week band (Rs 700-1,680 vs CMP ~Rs 1,244), consistent with a cyclical commodity name tracking ferrochrome/stainless-steel price swings rather than a structural re-rating.
